title: TEST HABERİ V2
summary: It means time is neutral; its value depends entirely on what you create or do with it. Swatch encourages you to act and make every second productive.
content: Swatch names every watch to give it a personality and a story. Instead of just selling a tool to tell time, Swatch sells fashion and self-expression, making each model unique and collectible.Swatch'ın tüm dünyada kaç tane Rolling Planet'i var?
